title: Patroni: switchover + RTO via the VIP
description: Runs `nexus failover-test cluster postgres`: patronictl switchover to a streaming replica, measures how fast the HAProxy VIP serves the new writable leader, then switches back.

observe.what: original leader -> new leader; RTO timeline. Live: ~4.6s.
inet_server_addr() flips to the new leader; pg_is_in_recovery()=false

whatProves: PatroniAdapter.FailoverAsync demonstrates the real HA primitive: patronictl switchover + HAProxy /leader re-routing; RTO measured at the operator's stable VIP endpoint. Requires the patroni.yml ctl: block (ADR-0013 bug #1).
